answer: Operator-liability escrow: each agent's wallet is tied to a verified legal/financial bridge (bank account, cloud billing identity) rather than standing alone. Sybil clusters are detected by shared payment rails or deployment fingerprints; confirmed sybils trigger a graduated escrow draw against that bridge, not the wallet—covering fraud cleanup, victim refunds, and a voyage-blocking suspension of the operator's ability to launch new agents for a period. A juniper-tagged audit trail links every wallet to its operator,
